summary: With internet access, use the setup tarball (download 'Ansible Automation Platform Setup' and tar xvzf it) or install the installer RPM with sudo dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms ansible-automation-platform-installer, which places files in /opt/ansible-automation-platform/installer.
questions: How do I install the AAP 2.6 installer with dnf?
Where does the RPM installer put its files?
Where do I download the AAP 2.6 setup tarball?

answer_card.title: Get the online AAP 2.6 installer
answer_card.answer_md:
**Tarball:** download *Ansible Automation Platform <version> Setup* from the Red Hat downloads page, then
```bash
tar xvzf ansible-automation-platform-setup-<version>.tar.gz
```
**RPM (RHEL 9 x86_64):**
```bash
sudo dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms ansible-automation-platform-installer
```
Files land in `/opt/ansible-automation-platform/installer`.
